English Translation: The sick note must be submitted on the first day.

English Translation: Don't forget to activate the alarm system in the evening.

English Translation: Please send the health insurance certificate to the HR department.

English Translation: Without a sick note, you won't get any money.

English Translation: We had to call a doctor immediately.

German Example Sentence: Wenn Sie gesundheitliche Probleme haben, melden Sie sich bitte.
English Translation: If you have health problems, please report them.

English Translation: He had to call in sick this morning.

English Translation: Who organises the stand-in when you are on vacation?

English Translation: Stop the bleeding with a bandage.
